info.name: Teachable Courses API
info.description:
Operations tagged Courses across 2 of this provider's published API definitions: teachable-admin-openapi.yml, teachable-oauth-openapi.yml. Each path carries the servers of the definition it was published in.

Contact Support:

 Email: support@teachable.com
